name: Germany Occupies Bohemia and Moravia
summary: WWII prelude: German troops occupy the Czech lands, proving Hitler's ambitions go beyond revising Versailles.

name: Italy Invades Albania
summary: WWII prelude: Fascist Italy invades and occupies Albania, expanding Axis control in the Balkans.

name: Pact of Steel
summary: WWII prelude: Germany and Italy sign a military alliance, tightening the Axis partnership before the European war.

name: Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact
summary: WWII: Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union sign a non-aggression pact with secret protocols dividing Eastern Europe into spheres of influence.

name: Germany Invades Poland
summary: WWII: Germany invades Poland, using airpower, armor, and rapid encirclement to begin the war in Europe.

name: Britain and France Declare War
summary: WWII: Britain and France declare war on Germany after the invasion of Poland.

name: Soviet Invasion of Poland
summary: WWII: The Soviet Union invades eastern Poland under the secret terms of the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact.

name: Warsaw Surrenders
summary: WWII: Warsaw surrenders after siege and bombing, marking the collapse of organized Polish resistance in the capital.

name: Winter War Begins
summary: WWII: The Soviet Union invades Finland after failed territorial negotiations, opening the Winter War.

name: USSR Expelled from League of Nations
summary: WWII / Winter War: The League of Nations expels the Soviet Union for attacking Finland.
